title: amsmath environment completeness
objective: Full amsmath display-environment support with numbering and \tag/\notag/\nonumber: align/align*/alignat/flalign/gather/multline/split/aligned/gathered/cases/dcases, matrix family incl. smallmatrix, \intertext, \substack, \overset/\underset, \xrightarrow/\xleftarrow, \DeclareMathOperator/\operatorname*, \text in subscripts, \dfrac/\tfrac/\binom sizes, \left/\right with \middle, \big family sizes, spacing commands \, \: \; \! \quad \qquad \phantom/\hphantom/\vphantom. Every construct gets an oracle test against MacTeX (word positions, not raw bytes).
acceptance: a tests/amsmath_corpus with ≥40 one-page oracle fixtures, all within 0.5pt of pdflatex word positions
notes: MacTeX is available on this machine: use it as the oracle (pdflatex word positions / rasters), never in the product path. Report on GitHub issue #2 with SHAs and test counts at every checkpoint; ack with `python3 scripts/coord.py ack`.
